capabilities: sync Discogs collection into one note per record
create a Base, folder and tag per record format
show dashboard charts of collection value, growth and pressings
browse records in a gallery, catalogue and value table
export the dashboard as a PDF
extras: Desktop only (PDF export uses Electron) and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installable via BRAT for pre-release versions; tokens are stored in Obsidian's keychain, never in vault files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a Discogs music collection into notes with structured metadata, price data and collection statistics.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns your Discogs collection into a music library in your vault
Each track links to its lyrics on Genius where a match is found.

summary: Syncs a Discogs record collection into one note per album with covers, tracklists, prices and lyrics links, plus a built-in dashboard and library.
